reviews.title: Losing my entries
reviews.text: This app is really hard to understand. It’s easy to write in, but it doesn’t keep your entries saved. I’ve used it for six months, and I don’t know what happened to all my entries, they disappeared. I thought maybe I’d forgotten to back them up, or that it was something on my end, so I started completely over. But when I logged in today, even yesterday’s entry was nowhere to be found. I don’t understand how to get this app to actually save entries. This is very frustrating for a journal app, since the whole point is being able to go back and read what you wrote.

reviews.title: Scam app switched to paywall
reviews.text: I had used this app for a while as a free place to keep track of thoughts, my daily history, and track my progress with self discovery and trauma healing.  I started using the free iPhone one a few years ago because it is more intuitive.  Today when I attempted to go back to see my old entries, and my progress over the years, it is now behind a paywall and none of my entries are accessible unless I sign up for a free trial and potential paid use.  My personal writing would never properly backup to cloud even when I was using it, so now all my writing is just gone.  Don’t get suckered by this scam.  Find a better app, your mental health is worth it.

reviews.title: Free then they change their minds
reviews.text: This was an eh app, you couldn’t copy and paste from anywhere so if you want to copy and paste a text message, you can’t. It doesn’t autocorrect anything you write so you have to constantly ensure you typed correctly yet now after using the app for 9 months for free, they want to change things and make it $15 a month. I was using this app to keep up with my ex-husbands abuse so I can try to take him back to court when I can afford to but now because of these people, I no longer have a place where I can journal this. I now no longer have access to what I’ve been writing because I have to pay to get in which I can’t afford to do right now. For an app that isn’t so great, this is an arm and a leg of a cost especially when you have been free. You couldn’t even offer a discount to those that have been using the app for awhile? Ridiculous. Quite the bait and switch. If I wanted / could pay for a journal app, I would have found a better one 9 months ago.
